"""RoboTwin 2.0 stack_blocks_two controller for rcb-limited/2.0.

Uses only calibrated RGB observations and the public arm proprioception. The
world-frame block locations are estimated by back-projecting color centroids
onto the known tabletop plane; every move starts from the observed EE poses.
"""
import json, os, sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output"
TABLE_Z = 0.74
BLOCK = 0.05
APPROACH_Q = np.array([0.7000007, 0.0, 0.0, 0.71414214], dtype=float)

def estimate_block_xy(obs, color):
    """Estimate block center from head-camera RGB and its calibrated extrinsic."""
    im = obs.last["head_camera"].astype(np.int16)
    R, G, B = (im[..., i] for i in range(3))
    if color == "green":
        mask = (G > R * 1.22) & (G > B * 1.10) & (G < 240) & (R < 235)
    else:
        mask = (R > G * 1.55) & (R > B * 1.35) & (R < 240) & (G < 220)
    yy, xx = np.where(mask)
    if len(xx) < 30:
        raise RuntimeError(f"could not see {color} block in head camera")
    u, v = float(xx.mean()), float(yy.mean())
    K = obs.meta["cameras"]["head_camera"]["intrinsic_cv"]
    E = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"]["head_camera"]["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    fx, fy, cx, cy = K[0][0], K[1][1], K[0][2], K[1][2]
    z = TABLE_Z + BLOCK / 2
    # Pixel ray in camera coordinates, transformed into world coordinates.
    ray_cam = np.array([(u-cx)/fx, (v-cy)/fy, 1.0])
    Rcw, tcw = E[:3,:3], E[:3,3]
    origin = -Rcw.T @ tcw
    ray = Rcw.T @ ray_cam
    t = (z-origin[2]) / ray[2]
    xyz = origin + t*ray
    return xyz[:2]

def observed_ee(obs):
    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return p[14:21].copy(), p[21:28].copy(), float(p[28]), float(p[29])

def make_action(left, right, lg, rg):
    return np.r_[left[:7], lg, right[:7], rg].astype(np.float32)

def move(r, obs, left=None, right=None, lg=None, rg=None, note=""):
    l0, r0, lg0, rg0 = observed_ee(obs)
    l = l0 if left is None else np.asarray(left, dtype=float)
    rr = r0 if right is None else np.asarray(right, dtype=float)
    result = r.submit("ee_pose", make_action(l, rr, lg0 if lg is None else lg,
                                               rg0 if rg is None else rg),
                      video="both", note=note)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUT, "run"), exist_ok=True)
    result.save(os.path.join(OUT, "run", note.replace(" ", "_") or "step"))
    print(json.dumps(result.meta, default=str))
    return result

def main():
    r = Robot()
    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
    print("time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
    print("green_xy", estimate_block_xy(obs, "green"), "red_xy", estimate_block_xy(obs, "red"))
    l0, r0, lg, rg = observed_ee(obs)
    green = estimate_block_xy(obs, "green")
    # Move above the green cube while preserving the observed vertical-grasp orientation.
    target = np.r_[green, 1.04, APPROACH_Q]
    move(r, obs, left=target, note="pregrasp_green")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
